title: Dimension-uniform structured W4 Schur recovery
statement: For every child dimension d>=6, the sufficient W4 shifted-inverse inequality L_3(C)>=(2/d)[C+(1-mu)I]^{-1} holds (i) when the support graph of C-I is an arbitrary signed matching, (ii) when it is an arbitrarily weighted three-vertex path plus isolated vertices, and (iii) when it is an equal-magnitude signed star plus isolates. Hence the full termwise outer Schur defect is recovered on these families.
assumptions: Support is either a matching, a single weighted three-vertex path plus isolates, or an equal-magnitude signed star plus isolates
open_objections: This does not cover overlapping paths, cycles, unequal-weight stars, or unrestricted W4.
No Lean formalization, external-human validation, or priority audit exists.
